Advisory.Description:
### Impact
`Snappy.uncompressCharArray`, `uncompressShortArray`, `uncompressIntArray`, `uncompressLongArray`, `uncompressFloatArray` and `uncompressDoubleArray` sized the result array by dividing the declared uncompressed byte length by the element size, but native code wrote the full byte length. If the declared length is not a multiple of the element size, up to 7 bytes are written past the end of the Java array, corrupting the heap.

### Patches
Fixed in 1.1.10.9 ([#739](https://github.com/xerial/snappy-java/pull/739)). These methods now reject uncompressed lengths that are not a multiple of the element size with `SnappyIOException`.

### Workarounds
Check that `Snappy.uncompressedLength(input)` is a multiple of the element size before calling these methods.
Advisory.Summary: snappy-java: Heap buffer overflow in Snappy.uncompress*Array typed-array methods
